summary: Finish now warns when a rebase leaves your stash behind, and the home screen stops reading git while a review is open. The warning comes first, then the home change; formatting-only test edits are skipped.

.tabthrough.session-idle-git.guide.json.rationale: This walk, written into the tree it describes

steps.title: Finish warns when your stash is left behind
steps.rationale: Where the warning text comes from; the next step shows it to the user
steps.notes: When a rebase finishes but git cannot put your stashed changes back, Finish now says so instead of closing silently. Git rewrites its progress line in place, so this reads only the last version of that line, the one a terminal would show.

steps.title: Finish shows the warning
steps.rationale: Finish used to close without a word in this case; now it shows the warning

steps.title: Home stops reading git during a review
steps.rationale: Why background git work stops once a review starts
steps.notes: While a review is open, the home screen stops asking git for remotes and history. Before, those reads kept running for the whole walk. Returning an empty home here is what lets them stop.

steps.title: Home reads git only when no review is open
steps.rationale: The same rule for the remotes and history lists
